t: This is Blue Peter, the British children's television programme, and the longest-running children's show in the world. It has been on air since October 1958. John Hunter Blair created it, after being asked by the BBC's head of children's television to devise something for children too old for Watch with Mother. The first edition lasted fifteen minutes. Biddy Baxter edited it from 1965 to 1988, and she devised much of the format still used today. For years it came from BBC Television Centre in London. It moved to Salford in 2011, and now comes from Campfield Studios in Manchester.
